makePost.q: How do I make a post?
makePost.a: Open Home, tap the microphone and say what you want to promote, then add a photo. We write the caption and design the poster. You review it, then decide whether to publish.

languages.a: Hindi, Marathi and English. Pick your language on the Create screen. If your browser cannot recognise voice, type your message instead.

approval.q: Will anything be posted without my approval?
approval.a: No. Posting only happens after you press Publish Now on the confirmation screen.

mic.q: Why does the microphone say it is blocked?
mic.a: Your browser needs permission to use the microphone. Click the lock icon next to the web address and allow the microphone, then try again.

accounts.a: Business or Creator accounts. Personal accounts cannot be connected.
